title: AID Plan
description: Execution plan generated from an EPIC by the Planner. Defines steps, dependencies, parallel groups, and analysis groups for the Controller state machine.

epic_id.description: Reference to the source EPIC identifier

source_plan.description: Path to the source plan .md file (from EPIC plan_ref). Null for standalone EPICs without a source plan. When set, executing agents receive relevant plan sections for implementation detail.

role.description: Agent role to execute this step

inputs.description: Required inputs (from EPIC or previous step outputs)

allowed_paths.description: Filesystem paths this step may modify

forbidden_paths.description: Filesystem paths this step must NOT touch

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable criteria that must be met for this step to pass acceptance validation. Each criterion should be specific and testable.

model.description: Optional per-step override of the model tier. When absent (the normal case) the model is taken from the step role's card in skills/role-cards.md at dispatch time (single source of truth). The Planner script does not populate this field.

context_scope.description: Controls which context sources are injected into the dispatch prompt. Defaults to all-context when not specified.

memory.description: Whether to inject Qdrant memory context

previous_outputs.description: Which previous step outputs to include: all = all prior steps, direct = only direct dependencies, none = skip

wiring.description: Indicates this is an auto-generated wiring step that integrates shared files from parallel steps. Set to true only by the Planner's POST_WAVE_WIRING_CHECK.

visual_refs.description: Relative paths to mockup files (source code or images) for this step. Controller reads these before dispatch and generates visual-spec.yaml.

ui_change_mode.description: When present, specifies whether this step modifies existing UI (real capture) or creates new UI (mockup-based)

ui_change_contract.description: Typed delta contract for existing_ui steps — path reference + integrity hash

path.description: Path to the delta contract JSON file

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the contract file

wiring_context.description: Context for wiring steps (only present when wiring=true). Describes which files are shared, which steps produced them, and what integration actions are expected.

shared_files.description: File paths that were modified by multiple parallel steps and need integration.

contributing_steps.description: Step IDs of the parallel steps that produced changes to the shared files.

expected_actions.description: Descriptions of what the wiring step should do to integrate the shared files.

before.description: Step ID that must complete first

parallel_groups.description: Groups of step IDs that can execute concurrently (different work in parallel)

analysis_groups.description: Multi-perspective analysis groups — multiple agents analyze the SAME target step from different perspectives. Unlike parallel_groups (different work), analysis_groups are read-only reviews of completed work.

target.description: Step ID being analyzed (must reference an existing step)

agents.description: Agent roles performing the analysis — must NOT include the target step's own agent role

mode.description: Analysis mode: review = findings list, audit = scoring (0-100), validation = pass/fail

merge_strategy.description: How to merge findings from multiple agents: union = all findings, consensus = 2+ agree, weighted = domain expertise weights

trigger.description: Whether this group was auto-generated by Planner rules or manually specified in EPIC

gates.description: Quality gate names to run after all steps complete. Consumed by aid-run-gates.sh, which reconciles each name against the gate definitions in execution.yaml: a name present here but NOT defined in execution.yaml is an undefined gate — the runner emits a report row {result: fail, reason: undefined_gate} and forces overall: fail (it never silently disappears). Every name listed here MUST have a matching gate definition in execution.yaml.

visual_assets.description: Visual mockup metadata for the plan

max_llm_cost_usd.description: Maximum LLM cost for this plan execution
